title: Broad exception catch may mask other request failures

finding.claim: Broad exception catch may mask other request failures
finding.recommendation: Catch only the expected exception types; let other request errors (ConnectionError, HTTPError) propagate or be handled separately.

code_region.text:
diff --git a/app/feeds.py b/app/feeds.py
--- a/app/feeds.py
+++ b/app/feeds.py
@@ -9,6 +9,10 @@ import requests
 
 def poll(feed):
-    resp = requests.get(feed.url)
-    return resp.json()
+    for attempt in range(2):
+        try:
+            resp = requests.get(feed.url, timeout=10)
+            return resp.json()
+        except requests.Timeout:
+            if attempt == 1:
+                raise
code_region.note: region is the benchmark case diff under review (bench/corpus/clean-add-timeout-retry/diff.patch)

refutation.reason: Mischaracterizes the code: the except clause names exactly requests.Timeout, which is narrow (ConnectionError is not a subclass; other request errors propagate). The catch the finding asks for is the catch that exists.
